locations.label: Exo Suit station
locations.description: Open the Sewers and take an Exo Suit. Open access to Atlas Command, Value Voltage and Burger Town and power equipment where needed. Locate the sewer decontamination pad before carrying infected quest items. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Golden frying pan
locations.description: From spawn’s highest crate, Exo-boost toward the cracked roof and collect the golden frying pan. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Four variable sewer valves
locations.description: Search the connected sewer pipes for four orange valves. Interact with each until steam vents. Their positions vary; inspect above and below the corridors and make another pass if a valve remains missing. After four successful interactions, the passage behind the waterfall opens. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Pan charging altar
locations.description: Place the pan on the altar inside the hidden chamber. The altar lowers to begin charging. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Burger cooking stove
locations.description: Kill zombies in the LOWER part of the altar room until the pan fills and the altar rises. Kills upstairs do not satisfy the collection area. Retrieve the charged pan and place it on Burger Town’s kitchen stove. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Decontamination pad
locations.description: Go directly to the sewer decontamination pad, using the Burger Town chute if convenient. Cleanse yourself while carrying the burger, then return and feed it to Bubby. His low-battery response starts the next phase. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Command battery and screen
locations.description: In Atlas Command, interact with the Bubby schematic screen inside one Command Center unit. Immediately run to the other unit containing the power generator and take the battery from its opened box. If it closes before pickup, activate the schematic again. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Battery charger
locations.description: Put the battery into the Value Voltage charger. Defend it from zombies; if they knock it out, pick it up and replace it. When fully charged it becomes red. Retrieve it and give it to Bubby. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Upstairs fingerprint scanner
locations.description: Use the arm on the upstairs spawn fingerprint scanner. Take the red tablet from the opened safe and install it at the burger’s Access Denied screen. You are forced outside as explosives and the rocket launch. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Insta-Gator trap
locations.description: Activate the sewer Insta-Gator trap. When the gator emerges holding a zombie, shoot it rapidly until it breaks and drops the floating zombie arm. Collect the arm. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
